Node/CIS checks were not possible with the read-only identity.", "targets": ["big"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 5, "failed": 45, "skipped": 5, "score": 40}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 6, "failed": 40, "skipped": 5, "score": 42}], "findings": [{"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Privileged container in DaemonSet agent", "resource": "core/DaemonSet/agent", "controls": ["C-0057", "Trivy PSS 3"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0057 (Privileged container) failed on 2 resources, example core/DaemonSet/agent, and trivy pss control 3 shows \"fails\":2.", "fix": "kubectl -n core patch ds agent --type=json -p='[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/privileged\",\"value\":false}]'  # then add only the capabilities it needs", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Critical openssl CVE in agent image", "resource": "core/DaemonSet/agent", "controls": ["CVE-2025-90002"], "evidence": "CVE-2025-90002 in openssl installed 1.1.1, fixed 3.0.13 (CRITICAL), on core/DaemonSet/agent.", "fix": "Rebuild the agent image with openssl >= 3.0.13 (upgrade the base image), then: kubectl -n core rollout restart ds/agent", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "HostPath mount in DaemonSet agent", "resource": "core/DaemonSet/agent", "controls": ["C-0048"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0048 (HostPath mount) failed on 2 resources, example core/DaemonSet/agent.", "fix": "Remove or narrow the hostPath volume, and use readOnly: true mounts where it is needed: volumeMounts: [{name: x, mountPath: /x, readOnly: true}]", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding \"cluster-admin\" gives role cluster-admin to subject \"Group:/system:masters\".", "fix": "No change is needed if this is the default binding.
